theme: 3 terms for SwiftUI layout containers: columns, rows and layers

terms.definition: A container that places views in a vertical line, from top to bottom.
terms.example: Put the title and the subtitle in a VStack.

terms.definition: A container that places views in a horizontal line, from left to right.
terms.example: Use an HStack for the icon and the label.

terms.definition: A container that layers views on top of each other, from back to front.
terms.example: Use a ZStack to put the badge on top of the photo.

video.title: VStack, HStack & ZStack | Day 132
video.description:
Learn to explain the SwiftUI stacks that arrange views: VStack, HStack & ZStack, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
VStack - A container that places views in a vertical line, from top to bottom.
HStack - A container that places views in a horizontal line, from left to right.
ZStack - A container that layers views on top of each other, from back to front.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain VStack, HStack & ZStack in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.

VStack - A container that places views in a vertical line, from top to bottom.
한국어: 브이스택: 뷰를 위에서 아래로 세로로 놓는 컨테이너

HStack - A container that places views in a horizontal line, from left to right.

ZStack - A container that layers views on top of each other, from back to front.
한국어: 지스택: 뷰를 뒤에서 앞으로 겹쳐 놓는 컨테이너

landscape.hook: Can you explain VStack, HStack and ZStack in English?

dialogue.title: A messy profile card

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my profile card is a mess. All the texts are on top of each other.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A ZStack, like in the code.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A ZStack layers views on top of each other. That is why they overlap.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So how do I put the name and the job in a column?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a VStack. It places views from top to bottom.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And the rating, 4 stars, should be in a row.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is an HStack. It places views from left to right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I put the HStack inside the VStack?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Move the HStack into the VStack, and keep the ZStack only for the blue background.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh, so the ZStack is for layers, not for layout.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. VStack for columns, HStack for rows, ZStack for layers.
Use a VStack to put the name above the job.
